name: home_elo
definition: Elo rating of the home club before the match
computation: start 1500, K=20, home advantage 60 only inside the expectation, goal-difference multiplier 1 / 1.5 / (11+gd)/8, updated only by CONFIRMED 90-minute results
null_handling: never NaN (1500 for unseen clubs; n_prior shows history length)
caveat: Level comparable only inside a connected rating component; use elo_diff for cross-league pooling

name: away_elo
definition: Elo rating of the away club before the match

name: elo_diff
definition: home_elo - away_elo
caveat: Comparable because both clubs are connected in the rating graph before the match (pair_connected_asof is required)

name: home_n_prior
definition: Number of earlier rated (confirmed 90-minute) matches of the home club in any openfootball competition
computation: uncapped count, strictly earlier calendar days
null_handling: 0 allowed in the file but rows need >= 5

name: away_n_prior
definition: same for the away club

name: home_ppg5
definition: Mean points per match over the last 5 earlier rated matches (any venue)

name: away_ppg5
definition: same for the away club

name: home_ppg10
definition: Mean points over the last 10 earlier rated matches

name: away_ppg10
definition: same, away club

name: home_gf5
definition: Mean goals scored over the last 5 earlier rated matches

name: home_ga5
definition: Mean goals conceded over the last 5 earlier rated matches

name: away_gf5
definition: as home_gf5 for the away club

name: away_ga5
definition: as home_ga5 for the away club

name: home_gf10
definition: Mean goals scored over the last 10 earlier rated matches

name: home_ga10
definition: Mean goals conceded over the last 10 earlier rated matches

name: away_gf10
definition: as home_gf10 for the away club

name: away_ga10
definition: as home_ga10 for the away club

name: home_venue_ppg5
definition: Mean points over the home club's last 5 earlier rated HOME matches
null_handling: NaN if fewer than 1 earlier home match (count of such rows in the data dictionary note)

name: away_venue_ppg5
definition: Mean points over the away club's last 5 earlier rated AWAY matches
null_handling: NaN if no earlier away match

name: ppg5_diff
definition: home_ppg5 - away_ppg5

name: gd5_diff
definition: (home_gf5 - home_ga5) - (away_gf5 - away_ga5)

name: home_days_rest
definition: Days since the home club's latest earlier completed match of any kind in the openfootball data
computation: any completed dated match, whatever its label
caveat: Known matches only: cups / European matches missing from the CC0 data (e.g. Europa and Conference League 2025-26) are not counted, so rest can be overstated

name: away_days_rest
definition: same for the away club

name: rest_diff
definition: home_days_rest - away_days_rest

name: league_tier
definition: Tier of the competition in its national pyramid (1 = top flight)

name: record_id
definition: Dataset row id (OF:competition:season_label:Lline)

name: split
definition: train / validation / test / forward_holdout by match date

name: y_90min_1x2
definition: H / D / A after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (confirmed only)

name: meta_latest_info_date
definition: latest earlier match used by the features

name: meta_pair_connected_asof
definition: home and away clubs were connected in the rating graph before the match

name: competition_id
definition: competition key; if used as a feature the vocabulary must be fitted on the training split

name: eval_primary
definition: validation/test/holdout row of a complete split-year league-season without identity flags

name: eval_secondary_calendar_year
definition: same, calendar-year leagues (cut by date, reported separately)

name: season_incomplete_flag
definition: league-season not verified complete

name: identity_review_flag
definition: club identity under review (unresolved twin / un-merged spelling)

name: same_country
definition: was wrong for 37.6% of rows (country parsed only from canonical ids)

name: neutral_known
definition: constant 0, no information

name: is_league / is_league_phase / is_knockout / comp_type_continental / comp_type_cup
definition: constant inside the league-only scope

name: home_goals_90 / away_goals_90 / half-time / final / penalty scores
